entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Yeah, finally. I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand Pulse. To get started, can I get your name and the order number?
The name is Sam Jones. The order number is... V-F-7-7-1-9-0-3. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. Are you going to process this return or do I need to speak to your manager?

Thank you, Sam. I've pulled up your account. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter! I don't like it. The battery is terrible, the app is clunky, and I just want to send it back. I don't need troubleshooting, I need a refund. I'll leave a review on every website telling people how terrible this thing is if I don't get one.
I understand your frustration, and I can definitely check the return eligibility for you. Just one moment while I review our current policy for your item.
Hurry up. This is ridiculous. Should be a simple yes or no.
Thank you for your patience, Sam. Okay, I've checked our system. Our company policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
And? It's been, what, like three weeks?
That's right. You received the item 19 days ago, which is well within the 90-day window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now.

Yes, of course. You're well within the timeframe. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it at any post office.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually much easier than I expected. Thank you.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today, Sam?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
